subsetPolicyRationale: `s.block.2d@1` is this plugin's own self-contained 2D block-construction document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (rename-node-kind, change-node-kind-label, change-node-kind-variant, change-node-kind-description, change-node-kind-icon, change-node-kind-unit, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
